items.title: Les Cròniques dels Nutrients
items.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one original wide landscape 16:9 illustration, a descriptive thumbnail for the secondary-school activity "Les Cròniques dels Nutrients", about the journey of food through digestion and absorption. A beautifully drawn educational model of the human digestive tract is the unmistakable subject, in a softly outlined head-and-torso silhouette: mouth and oesophagus leading to a stomach, coiled small intestine enclosed by the larger colon, anatomically coherent. Warm orange arrows trace the journey downward. At the right, one large circular close-up of intestinal villi shows tiny nutrient particles passing across the lining to red capillary vessels. On the left foreground a small piece of bread and an apple connect the food to the start of the journey. This is a gamified journey in the real artifact, but use no cartoon faces on organs and no unrelated laboratory equipment. Fine dark ink contours, expressive warm watercolor washes, subtle paper grain, professional hand-painted animation background style matching an educational physics watercolor illustration: ivory and pale lavender background, deep purple supporting marks, orange second most present accent. Fill the wide frame with the topic-specific scene; central safe area readable at small card size. Flat illustrated art only, not photographic realism, not shiny 3D, not a screenshot, no card grid, no title, no labels, no invented chemical structures, no watermark. The illustration must distinguish digestion from a healthy-food plate.
items.repairPrompt: Edit the supplied watercolor digestive-system illustration with one scientific correction only: REMOVE EVERY yellow/orange direction arrow and EVERY colored food/nutrient dot from the LARGE INTESTINE/COLON (the thick outer tube surrounding the small intestine), including both lateral vertical parts, the top horizontal part and the bottom rectal area. Those arrows currently imply an incorrect anatomical transit direction. Leave the entire thick colon as an uncluttered anatomical outer tube, without arrows. Preserve arrows in the mouth, oesophagus, stomach, and the thin coiled small intestine and preserve the absorption/villi inset. Keep all other art, layout, style, colors, bread/apple and background unchanged. No new text or symbols.
items.rationale: El recurs recorre boca, esòfag, estómac, duodè, intestí prim amb absorció i intestí gros. La imatge il·lustra el recorregut i amplia vellositats i pas de nutrients a la sang.
items.qa: Inspecció visual completa. Primera versió tenia fletxes incorrectes al còlon; reparades amb imagegen. La final no dóna direcció de trànsit al còlon i destaca digestió i absorció. Sense etiquetes ni afirmacions numèriques.

items.title: Detectiu d’Etiquetes Alimentàries
items.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one original wide landscape 16:9 educational illustration for "Detectiu d’Etiquetes Alimentàries": a nutrition-label investigation, NOT a healthy-food plate. Foreground central subject: a large magnifying glass held over a plain yogurt pot's back-side nutrition table, next to a cereal carton turned to its nutrition panel; a pencil and open investigation notebook record comparison data, a simple calculator and a small balance appear as secondary supporting tools. Magnifier clearly enlarges rows of the nutrition label. Exact minimal words on label, if legible: "100 g", "Sucres", "Saturats", "Proteïnes", "Sal". Use a few plausible small numerical values without claims or brand logos. Notebook has simple hand-drawn comparison bars in orange and purple, not a health verdict. This real artifact compares nutrition per 100 g and food category, with energy, sugars, saturated fat, protein and salt. Fine dark ink, warm watercolor/cel-style hand-painted animation illustration, subtle paper texture, ivory/pale lavender wash, purple and orange accents, inviting but professional secondary-school educational art. Large topic-specific objects, fill wide frame, central composition safe at thumbnail size. No people required. No photographic realism, no shiny 3D, no app screenshot, no decorative fruit plate, no slogan, no logos, no watermark.
items.repairPrompt: Edit the supplied nutrition investigation watercolor, preserve its objects, framing, yogurt nutrition table in the magnifying glass, cereal nutrition table, calculator, palette and drawing style. Make the drawing MUCH less text-heavy. Remove ALL slogans, sentences and lettering from sticky notes, pencil, pen holder, plant pot, book spines and large board at back left; leave those surfaces plain colored paper or wood. Replace the notebook's right-hand chart with a simple untitled observation sketch of two food containers and pencil marks, no axes, no bars and no numerical comparisons. Energy and grams must not be compared on one axis. Keep the left notebook as short pencil observation lines, not another densely lettered data table. No new words anywhere. The nutrition panels on yogurt and cereal are the ONLY readable text remaining. This is a descriptive educational illustration, not a poster or an infographic.
items.rationale: El formulari real introdueix per 100 g energia, sucres, greixos saturats, proteïnes i sal i categoria d’aliment. Lupa sobre etiqueta de iogurt i cereal, calculadora i notes d’observació.
items.qa: Inspecció completa. Reparada primera versió per eliminar eslògans no demanats i gràfic que comparava kcal i grams al mateix eix. Final només etiqueta nutricional amb exemple plausible; no veredicte de salut ni barres amb unitats barrejades.

items.title: Argumentació científica
items.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one original wide landscape 16:9 illustration for a classroom scientific argumentation activity about critically refuting a misleading viral nutrition opinion. Central desk scene: a printed opinion article with two highlighted passages in orange, a large magnifying glass above one questionable passage, and a separate open evidence notebook showing a drawn three-step logical chain of claim, evidence, conclusion using simple box shapes connected by purple arrows. To the right, reference book and a small nutrition table with data, a pencil linking observations back to the article. A hand-drawn speech bubble holding a question mark over the opinion and a small check mark next to checked evidence make the critical-reading task immediately readable. Small food drawings on the article margin may show vegetables, beans and grains; do NOT depict vegetables crossed out or endorse the false article. The actual exercise critiques fake nutrition claims and sorts lies, fallacies and false data before writing counterarguments. Minimal exact text only if needed: article header "OPINIÓ", notebook header "PROVES". Fine dark ink contours, soft warm watercolor, subtle paper grain, hand-painted animation style; ivory and pale lavender, deep purple and warm orange accents. Professional secondary school visual, descriptive objects fill frame, central safe area, no people needed. Not a healthy-food plate, no photo, no 3D, no app screenshot, no invented slogan, no health claims, no watermark.
items.rationale: La pàgina real conté una opinió viral sobre alimentació, selecció de mentides/fal·làcies/dades falses i registre de contraarguments. La imatge contraposa opinió amb interrogant, evidències nutricionals i conclusió.
items.qa: Inspecció completa. La composició mostra lectura crítica i proves; no avala la notícia falsa. Les dades il·lustratives nutricionals són plausibles per aliments cuits. Té més paraules secundàries del que es demanava al prompt (instruccions pedagògiques a objectes), però sense eslògans promocionals ni afirmacions falses.

items.title: La química de l’amor
items.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one original wide landscape 16:9 scientific illustration for "La química de l’amor", a secondary-school article linking nervous system, hormonal messengers and bodily responses when someone has a crush. Center a respectful gender-neutral human head-and-upper-torso profile silhouette, entirely drawn, with the brain clearly visible as the main control center. Fine purple neural signal lines leave the brain; orange small messenger dots travel in a red blood vessel toward an anatomically stylized heart and stomach, both shown as inset diagrams on the right. A small discreet outlined heart symbol floats near the forehead as the emotional context; the scientific brain-to-body connection is dominant, no romance scene. Two magnified circular details show a neuron communicating across a synapse and messenger particles in bloodstream near a target cell receptor, conceptually distinct. Do not use chemical molecular formulas or butterflies physically inside the stomach; no arrows pretending dopamine directly pumps the heart. Fine dark ink contours, warm watercolor washes, subtle paper texture, professional hand-painted animation illustration. Ivory/pale lavender backdrop, purple primary accent and orange second most present, restrained salmon organ colors. Large descriptive subject, readable at thumbnail, central safe area, fill wide composition. No labels or title, no photos, no shiny 3D, no app UI, no magical potion, no people kissing, no watermark.
items.rationale: L’article demana distingir sistema nerviós, hormones i òrgans/efectes. La il·lustració posa el cervell al centre i diferencia sinapsi de missatgers a la sang amb resposta corporal al cor/estómac.
items.qa: Inspecció completa. Silueta dibuixada, dues ampliacions conceptuals i òrgans recognoscibles, sense molècules etiquetades, insectes a l’estómac o claims fisiològics concrets. No reprodueix afirmacions simplificadores de la lectura.
items.independentRepairPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: the attached drawn educational illustration for "La química de l'amor", a brain, body, blood vessel close-up and heart/stomach call-outs.
Primary correction: the current red conduit with orange molecules descending directly from the brain along the spinal cord incorrectly confuses neuronal conduction and hormone transport. Correct that single route.
Keep the face silhouette, brain, circular synapse inset at upper left, blood-vessel inset at lower left, central heart, heart/stomach insets on the right, purple/orange fine ink and watercolor style, framing and rest of composition.
In the head and neck, remove completely the descending RED tube and its orange molecule beads that follows the spine from the brain stem towards the chest. In its place show a distinct thin PURPLE spinal cord and purple branching peripheral nerves only, with a few violet electrical spark accents, NO glowing orange molecule beads travelling along them. Purple neural lines must stay visually separate from the red blood vessels.
Keep the horizontal red blood vessels across the lower chest and the lower-left red blood inset, containing orange hormonal messenger dots travelling in blood. Those red blood vessels must remain in the chest and blood inset; they must not appear as a direct pipe leading from the brain into the nervous system.
The upper-left enlarged synaptic cleft may keep its orange dots locally crossing the tiny gap, representing synaptic neurotransmitters; these dots must never flow along the purple nerve fibers.
No new words, formulas or labels, no extra organs needed. Clear educational distinction: electrical neuronal route in purple, circulatory hormone route in red vessels with orange dots. Keep all other artwork unchanged.
items.independentRepairQA: Replaced the incorrect red brain-to-spine conduit with separate purple nerve fibers. Hormone messenger dots remain in the red bloodstream and local synaptic inset only; no molecular transport along spinal nerve fibers.

items.title: Protocol Pubertat
items.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one original wide landscape 16:9 illustration for "Protocol Pubertat", a school investigation into nervous, hormonal and reproductive systems whose final product is a student-created scientific card game called REPRO-RACE. Main subject: tabletop arrangement of six large beautiful hand-drawn educational game cards in warm orange and deep purple bordered decks; one card has a brain/pituitary icon, one a hormone messenger traveling in bloodstream, one a uterus with ovaries anatomical teaching diagram, one a pair of testes anatomical teaching diagram, and one egg-cell and sperm diagram. Next to the cards is a clearly depicted physical circular cycle wheel with four differently colored sections and a pointer, without day numbers or a misleading fixed physiological schedule. A notebook and pencil suggest designing and researching the game. Show a light dotted relationship trail connecting brain, messenger and organ cards, rather than battle violence. Restrained clinical biology diagrams, age-appropriate secondary-school classroom imagery, no bodies in sexual situations, no nudity scene. Art is fine dark ink with warm watercolor/cel style and subtle paper grain, hand-painted animation still, ivory/lavender background, orange second most prominent after purple. Objects large and descriptive, fill wide frame and center safe area. Exact text only "REPRO-RACE" on box edge if included, no other words or numerical claims. No photorealism, shiny 3D, screenshot, contact sheet, cute anthropomorphic genital characters, slogans or watermark.
items.repairPrompt: Make one targeted edit to the supplied REPRO-RACE watercolor card-game illustration: change ONLY the four-sector round spinner on the right. Its four sectors must be respectively muted RED, warm ORANGE, golden YELLOW, and PURPLE (the actual classroom game's cycle wheel colors). REMOVE the sun, brain, leaf and water icons inside that spinner: leave four clean colored sectors, thin dividing lines, central pivot and existing pointer. No labels, no day numbers, no new icons. Keep all cards, anatomy sketches, notebook, box and REPRO-RACE lettering, style and composition exactly unchanged.
items.rationale: L’artefacte té indagació hormonal, estudi dels aparells reproductors i creació del joc REPRO-RACE amb cartes i roda de cicle. Imatge cartes cervell/hipòfisi, missatgers a sang, úter/ovaris, testicles, gàmetes i roda.
items.qa: Inspecció completa. Corregida roda inicial amb símbols genèrics: final utilitza els quatre colors reals vermell, taronja, groc i morat. Sense dies ni claims fisiològics fixos; dibuixos biològics clínics adequats a secundària, sense sexualització.

items.title: Som iguals?
items.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one original wide landscape 16:9 professional school illustration for "Som iguals?", a classroom activity observing and collecting visible traits such as eye color, hair color/texture and freckles to study variability and probability. Show four secondary-school students with visibly different natural hair colors and textures, different skin tones and freckles, sitting together at one observation desk, shoulders and faces drawn naturally in a gentle hand-painted animation style, not caricatures. One holds a little mirror, another marks an observation tally on paper. Foreground very readable open notebook contains eye-color swatches and tally strokes beside a simple purple/orange frequency bar chart. A hand-held magnifying glass above the notebook reinforces observing data. Classroom lavender wash background, fine ink contours, warm watercolor paper texture, purple primary graphic accent and orange second most present, neutral ivory/orange clothing. The image is about observing diversity in a class and careful comparison, not diagnosing students, not ranking people. No DNA connecting directly to eye/hair swatches, no dominant/recessive symbols, no Punnett square, no identical cloned students, no tongue-rolling gene claim, no real student names or personal data. Fill wide landscape, large readable subjects central safe area. No photos, shiny 3D, app screenshots, title, slogan or watermark.
items.rationale: El recurs demana observar color d’ulls, cabell/forma, pigues i altres trets, abans de recollir variabilitat del grup. La imatge mostra companys observant trets i anotant recomptes/freqüències; no afirma una herència mendeliana simple.
items.qa: Inspecció completa. Quatre adolescents dibuixats, diversitat natural i observació amb mirall/quadern. Sense dades de persones reals, gens dominants/recessius, connexions ADN→trets o quadrats de Punnett. Reparada inconsistència original entre marques i barres: exemple il·lustratiu de recomptes 10, 7, 4, 6; la gràfica no es presenta com una prova genètica.
items.repairPrompt: Make a precise small data-consistency correction to the supplied watercolor classroom observation illustration. Keep all students, desk, hair observations, notebook eye drawings, tally strokes, palette, art style and composition unchanged. Edit ONLY the four bars of the notebook chart on the right. They must align with the eye-color tally rows on the left: from left to right the bar heights are exactly 10, 7, 4, 6 on the existing y-axis (0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10). The first purple bar reaches 10, the second orange bar reaches halfway between 6 and 8, third purple bar reaches 4, fourth orange bar reaches 6. Preserve bar widths, colors, spacing and the four eye-color symbols beneath them. No extra text or new symbols.

items.title: Joc de rol enginyeria genètica
items.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one original wide landscape 16:9 descriptive illustration for a classroom role-playing debate "El Dilema del Valle de la Vida", about whether Andorra should permit a proposed CRISPR genetic-editing clinic. Show a roundtable with five drawn adult representatives, clearly different professions: genetic scientist with lab coat, patient-association representative with a simple folder containing a healthcare heart icon, conservation ecologist with a leaf notebook, bioethics philosopher with a small balance-of-justice symbol on a document, and government representative with a civic-building folder. They respectfully discuss evidence cards spread on the table, with one person pointing at a large central illustrated DNA double helix card and another considering a document. A small window behind shows Pyrenean mountain outlines, establishing Andorra without flags or logos. DNA and deliberation are central; no fetus, no designer baby, no monstrous creature, no physical cut to a person. Draw exactly five participants and large enough cards, coherent scene, no panels or contact sheet. Fine dark ink contours, soft warm watercolor, subtle paper grain and hand-painted animation character style, professional secondary-school art, ivory/pale lavender, purple accent and orange second most prominent. Fill wide frame, central safe area. No text required, no photographic realism, shiny 3D, UI screenshot, simplistic good-versus-evil framing, slogans or watermark.
items.rationale: L’artefacte El Dilema del Valle de la Vida presenta una proposta de clínica CRISPR al Govern d’Andorra amb cinc rols: genetista, pacients, ecologia, bioètica i Govern. La imatge retrata exactament aquest debat amb documents d’ADN i Pirineus.
items.qa: Inspecció completa. Cinc participants, professions diferenciades per documents/símbols, deliberació neutral al voltant d’ADN. Sense nadons de disseny, mutacions fantàstiques o claims terapèutics. El document d’ADN és conceptual, no model molecular de bases.
